The non-standard task list extensions stay off unless asked for:
with plain TaskList these are all ordinary text.

-- parser.json --
{"TaskList": true}
-- mark.md --
- [ ] todo
- [u] unknown
- [T] spawn
- [?] huh
- [✓] check
-- mark.html --
<ul>
<li><input disabled="" type="checkbox"> todo</li>
<li>[u] unknown</li>
<li>[T] spawn</li>
<li>[?] huh</li>
<li>[✓] check</li>
</ul>
-- name.md --
- [ ].a foo
- [x].ab bar
- [t].a baz
-- name.html --
<ul>
<li>[ ].a foo</li>
<li>[x].ab bar</li>
<li>[t].a baz</li>
</ul>
